notes: The contents (فہرست) is on image 4, laid out as a two-column table read right to left (items 1–10 in the right half, 11–19 plus فرہنگ in the left half). The page-number cell for item 10 (لڑی میں پروئے ہوئے منظر) appears blank/illegible in the scan, so page is null. Page numbers are printed in Urdu numerals and have been converted to integers. The final entry 'فرہنگ' (glossary, p. 135) is back matter and has been excluded. Author names are printed in the same cell as the titles and are retained; some poets' names carry a taskhees/madd mark that may be rendered imperfectly. Titles with numbering 17 as printed reads 'ہے تیر افسانہ کیا' which is likely a typo for 'ہے تیرا افسانہ کیا' · transcribed as printed.
